Apply online for a pool loan Get free estimate & 3D design Order a free pool brochure What is the process for building a gunite pool in Dallas? (concrete / shotcrete) Gunite pool construction involves multiple phases. After planning and designing the pool, these steps typically include: permitting, layout, excavation , steel installation, plumbing, electric, gunite application, installation of tile and coping, deck installation, plaster/interior finish , and start-up. The sequence here may vary based on local building codes and practices, as well as if the project contains any specialized custom design features. How long does it take to build a gunite pool? With normal backyard conditions and weather that allows for the construction to proceed, builders in many areas of the country usually need eight to 10 weeks from excavation to complete a typical residential gunite pool. In some geographic markets, build times average a few weeks longer. In general, the more complex the design and the more special features it has, the more time your project will take. Other variables often extend build times. Among them: time of year, permits/variances, difficult building conditions (e.g., property access, hitting groundwater, subterranean rock, or unmarked utility lines), addendums to change the design or features customer payment progress adjacent outdoor features under construction, and custom material choices requiring a special order. Above all, weather conditions , such as rain or extreme heat and humidity, can cause delays. Gunite construction is multiphase—requiring a series of steps using various tradesmen for each. Reputable pool builders adhere to the timelines and terms outlined in the sales contract. What underground obstacles can hinder inground pool construction? Beneath the ground in the Metroplex, several conditions can slow or impede pool construction. Examples include underground rock, extended tree roots, a high local water table (in which water from the earth seeps into an excavated hole), and buried utility lines that utility-reporting services did not identify. While qualified pool contractors use strategies to overcome most of these subterranean hurdles, build schedules often must be extended. Learn more: Backyard Conditions that Impact Building Costs How do soil conditions affect inground pool construction? Soil that expands, contracts, shifts, or is unstable for other reasons can impact a pool’s construction and long-term stability. For example, in an open excavated hole, sandy soil may cause the walls to collapse. Soil with a high clay content may expand or contract with seasonal temperature or moisture changes. Professional pool contractors are accustomed to these kinds of challenges and have solutions for the majority of them. Tactics vary by the nature of the challenge and building practices in the local market. Learn more here: Backyard Conditions that Impact Building Costs How do inground pool builders in Dallas address special soil conditions for gunite pools? Builders use a variety of techniques to overcome soil challenges for gunite pool construction. Methods often vary by region of the country. For example, to address unstable earth, they may lay a bed of compacted fill with pea gravel in the excavated hole or increase the amount of gunite and steel in the pool shell. To address sandy soil, they may frame the excavated hole with plywood to hold its shape until gunite is applied. In certain cases, an analysis by a soil engineer may be needed, and more extensive tactics may be required. data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic and positive, detailing a smooth design and build process with specific, praised staff. However, a clear, credible pattern emerges from negative reviews: significant post-construction quality issues (leaks, cracks) and poor warranty/service responsiveness. The company appears excellent at sales and project management but has inconsistent follow-through on defects.
fake_signals: Repetitive, promotional-sounding Yelp snippet appears in multiple search results
Some 5-star Google reviews are effusive but lack specific negative balance

negative_evidence: Hannah Hooks states attempts to get a response were met with 'eerie silence' and 'complete disregard for our warranty'
Alexis's review initially noted unresolved cracks and a leak
positive_evidence: Alexis Michaelkovich's updated review states they 'fixed the leak' and 'fixed the mortar'

authentic_signals: Detailed project narratives with specific staff names (Mitch, David, James, Zach, Lisa)
Specific timelines and project details mentioned
Authentic complaint with specific issue (7 leaks, 30,000-gallon pool)
Balanced 3-star review details a resolution process
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google (4.3), Yelp (4.7), and BBB (A+). Minor variance is normal for different user bases. Low review counts on Angi (4.5) and Trustpilot (3.9) are not statistically significant.

reviews.text:
From start to finish, Blue Haven Pools delivered an absolutely outstanding experience. The process began with Mitch, who walked us through the design phase with incredible attention to detail. He took the time to explain every option and, most importantly, the pricing. Everything was clear, transparent, and laid out upfront—there were truly no surprises at any point in the process.

Once construction began, the experience only got better. David managed the build with exceptional professionalism. The communication was phenomenal: daily email updates from startup to completion kept us informed every step of the way. Each phase of construction was explained clearly, timelines were communicated, and the craftsmanship and attention to detail were impressive.

The final startup with Dwayne was the perfect conclusion to the project. He thoroughly explained how to operate and maintain the pool, walked us through all the equipment, helped install and understand the app, and reviewed all warranty information. We left feeling confident, informed, and fully prepared to enjoy our pool.

Blue Haven Pools has truly mastered customer service, communication, and quality workmanship. I cannot say enough good things about this company. They exceeded our expectations in every way, and I would wholeheartedly recommend them to friends and family. If you’re looking for a pool company that is honest, organized, and delivers exactly what they promise, Blue Haven Pools is it.
reviews.author: Nanette Huntley

reviews.text: From the first design meeting with Mitch and Dwayne, who really listened and turned our ideas into the perfect backyard oasis, to working with Zach as our project manager who kept everything on track and always gave straight answers, the entire experience with Blue Haven Pools was outstanding. My absolute favorite was Lisa, who handled the financing with incredible patience, answering every call almost instantly. We had a few normal construction hiccups, but that’s just how construction goes, and they jumped on every issue immediately. What truly sets Blue Haven apart is their communication, someone was always available, day or night, weekends included, so we never felt in the dark or stressed like the horror stories I’ve heard from friends who used other companies. Our pool and covered patio is gorgeous and we’re out there every chance we get, but the best part was how easy and enjoyable the whole process felt because of this amazing team. I recommend Blue Haven one hundred percent.
reviews.author: Jeff Whitley

reviews.text: I can't say enough about Blue Haven Pools. If I could give 10 stars, I would! Our designer, James was AMAZING!!! We met with multiple pool companies, and they all offered basically the same generic design. James,  unlike the others offered something we never would have thought of. We had some pretty tough "needs", and James somehow managed to fit them all in in such a unique way. Also his communication couldn't have been better throughout the entire process.  Now onto our project manager, Zack. Again, can't say enough about his communication and attention to detail. We literally received an email every day informing us of the next step. Our project was done in 7 weeks and we had zero delays thanks to Zack's scheduling. Overall, great experience, and I can't recommend them enough!
reviews.author: Tami

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Blue Haven Pools. I was really on the fence regarding investing in the pool. James came out, helped us through the process. He really listened to what I wanted and kept our budget in mind-we chose the upgrades we felt were important. Together we designed a beautiful pool for our small yard. They started construction the first week of August and completed the first week in September! Yes, 30 days!  And yes we are still using it in October! Zach  led construction, kept us informed throughout the process. I will never regret pulling the trigger on this project, we’ve had such great quality family time with this pool! You can trust this team to get it right!
reviews.author: Deanna Cravens

reviews.text:
First off, this was one of the best experiences and it has been a huge life changer for us. The pool and hot tub addition has turned our house into a twelve month of the year vacation oasis. Day or night, hot or cold outside it’s our new swim up suite. The crew at Blue Haven Pools & Spas were awesome and did everything they said they would and could. From  James creating the exact design and plan and walking us through every step, to Mitch agreeing to our great plan and handling the financing side, to Zach overlooking the construction and making sure everything was done right, even as far as pressure washing the front of the house after the trucks were gone. Such a professional job from first communication to their continued support now. We are so happy and recommend Blue Haven Pools & Spas to everyone we see.
Thanks again from
The Walrus and his Queen!!!!!
reviews.author: Derek Brandow

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Blue Haven pools building my pool this summer. I was told approximately eight weeks barring any delays with weather or permits. From June 14 to August 10 as promised we had water. The process was professional and the construction site was always clean and safe. The pool design is wonderful thanks to James Zimmerman my sales consultant and designer. This was my second Blue Haven pool build. I love the Travertine stones and waterfall. I am very happy with the process and recommend Blue Haven of Lewisville Tx.
reviews.author: sandra johnson

reviews.text:
Update 4/16: Blue Haven seems to have fixed the issues with the pool. They fixed the mortar between the flag stone and tiles, and fixed the leak. However, the cracks are still in our patio. They attempted to fill the cracks with concrete but this did not do much. I’m updating my stars to 3/5 because they did work with me to resolve (hopefully) 2 of the main issues and as stated previously the initial build process was smooth.

Update 2/26: our pool is now having additional issues, losing 1 and 1/2 inches of water within a 24 hour period. I am having to add water every other day to keep my equipment running. I have now had to shut my equipment off completely and the leak is likely in the plumbing. This is causing major issues with the flagstone and concrete deck. My pool is now just 4 months old and should not have these issues.

Update 2/19: Blue Haven is actively working with us to get the issues resolved. They have been responsive and easy to work with.

Our pool build was completed roughly 2 months ago. 1 week after the pool decking was laid we woke up to a 10 foot crack across the whole patio. When this was brought to blue havens attention they said it’s not under warranty and there is nothing they would do to fix it. Our flag stone is now pulling away from the pool. I called blue haven to make them aware of this and they once again said if it is due to ground shifting it would not be covered under warranty. No pool should have this issue 2 months after the build. Blue Haven is supposed to come out to look at the issue. Hoping this can get resolved. Our pool build otherwise was smooth and the pool is nice.
reviews.author: Alexis Michaelkovich

reviews.text: Our experience with Blue Haven Pools has been an absolute nightmare. This is our second pool with them, and it's been nothing short of a disaster. The plumbing crew rushed through the 30,000-gallon pool in a mere 6 hours, resulting in shoddy workmanship that we immediately flagged. Seven leaks have plagued our pool, each fixed with visible reluctance. Now, facing yet another leak, our attempts to get a response from Blue Haven have been met with eerie silence and a complete disregard for our warranty. Holes in the deck from previous leaks remain untouched, showcasing their utter lack of accountability. This has been an appalling display of incompetence and negligence from a company we foolishly trusted for a second time.
reviews.author: Hannah Hooks
